text:
Amr Moussa, Arab League Secretary-General from 2001 to 2011, is the one who sponsored the first Arab Creativity Oscar, which went to Mishary Alafasy in 2008. The team note's claim that Ahmed Aboul Gheit sponsored it doesn't hold up: he took office in 2016, so he could not have sponsored a 2008 award. Sources are still wiki-style pages, such as [EverybodyWiki](https://en.everybodywiki.com/Mishary_bin_Rashid_Alafasy), and I could not find a primary report.

CONFIDENCE: 70
